title: build save never overwrites a file of jitso/builds/ and never takes the id of a saved build of any layer, even with a good token; nothing is written or deleted
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D7 and B3-18/B3-19 (a draft becomes a build only with the owner's OK: a terminal, or the token of the content he read; the guard denies the agent)
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-15, drafts; docs/decisions.md D7). A draft whose id is the id of a saved build of the project is `JITSO REJECTED: jitso/builds/<id>.yaml already exists: save never overwrites a build`; so is a draft whose target file exists under another id. A draft whose id a build of another layer already has (here the user folder) is `JITSO REJECTED: build "<id>" already exists (<layer> <path>): a draft needs an id no build has`. The check comes before the token: the answer is the same with a bogus `--confirm`. The saved file and the draft are left as they were.
